fields.summary_ko.0: Seagate Technology Holdings plc (STX) rose 125% year-to-date, outperforming the computer integrated systems industry (+98.1%).
fields.summary_ko.1: STX's fiscal Q2 revenue guidance of $4.8 billion (±$100 million) projects 70% year-over-year growth, with HAMR-based Mozaic roadmap and long-term supply contracts driving margin expansion and cash generation.
